theorem no_closable_gammaLaplace_mobius_operator (r : Ioi (0:ℝ)) :
    ¬ ∃ T : HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2 →ₗ.[ℂ] HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2,
      T.IsClosable ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,

theorem no_closable_gammaLaplace_mobius_operator (r : Ioi (0:ℝ)) :
    ¬ ∃ T : HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2 →ₗ.[ℂ] HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2,
      T.IsClosable ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
        (gammaLaplaceAtom r n,
          (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n+1) : ℂ) • gammaLaplaceAtom r n) ∈ T.graph
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rintro ⟨T, ⟨U, hU⟩, hT⟩
  let G := T.graph.topologicalClosure
  have hclosed : IsClosed (G : Set (HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2 × HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2)) :=
    isClosed_closure
  have hfour (n : ℕ) : (gammaLaplaceAtom r (4*(n+1)-1), 0) ∈ G := by
    apply Submodule.le_topologicalClosure
    have h := hT (4*(n+1)-1)
    rw [show 4*(n+1)-1+1=4*(n+1) by omega, mobius_four_mul_zero] at h
    simpa using h
  have hspan : ∀ v ∈ gammaSquarefulAtomSpan r, (v,0) ∈ G := by
    intro v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem v hv => obtain ⟨n,rfl⟩ := hv; exact hfour n
    | zero => exact G.zero_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa using G.add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => simpa using G.smul_mem c hx
  have hhor (v : HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2) : (v,0) ∈ G :=
    (hclosed.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).closure_subset_iff.mpr
      hspan (dense_gammaSquarefulAtomSpan r v)
  have hdiag : (gammaLaplaceAtom r 0,gammaLaplaceAtom r 0) ∈ G := by
    apply Submodule.le_topologicalClosure
    simpa using hT 0
  have hvertical : ((0 : HTGeometry.BurnolHalfLineL2),gammaLaplaceAtom r 0) ∈ G := by
    simpa using G.sub_mem hdiag (hhor (gammaLaplaceAtom r 0))
  change (0,gammaLaplaceAtom r 0) ∈ T.graph.topologicalClosure at hvertical
  rw [hU] at hvertical
  exact gammaLaplaceAtom_ne_zero r 0 (U.graph_fst_eq_zero_snd hvertical rfl)

theorem adjoin_generator_mobius {y z : E} (hy : Transcendental C y)
    (hz : z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin C {y})
    (hyin : y ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin C {z}) :
    ∃ a b c d : C, a * d - b * c ≠ 0 ∧
      z * (algebraMap C E c * y + algebraMap C E d)
        = algebraMap C E a * y + algebraMap C E b
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  set φ := RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental y hy with hφ
  set g : RatFunc C := φ.symm ⟨z, hz⟩ with hgdef
  have hevg : ratFuncEval y hy g = z := by
    simp only [ratFuncEval, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
      hgdef, hφ, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  -- `g` generates `RatFunc C`
  have hggen : IntermediateField.adjoin C {g} = ⊤ := by
    have hXmem : (RatFunc.X : RatFunc C) ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin C {g} := by
      have hmem : ratFuncEval y hy RatFunc.X
          ∈ IntermediateField.map (ratFuncEval y hy)
            (IntermediateField.adjoin C {g}) := by
        rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_map]
        simp only [Set.image_singleton, hevg, ratFuncEval_X]
        exact hyin
      rw [IntermediateField.mem_map] at hmem
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ := hmem
      rwa [ratFuncEval_injective y hy hwx] at hw
    rw [← top_le_iff, ← RatFunc.adjoin_X]
    exact IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hXmem)
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, hdet, hrel⟩ := ratFunc_generator_mobius hggen
  refine ⟨a, b, c, d, hdet, ?_⟩
  have hpush := congrArg (ratFuncEval y hy) hrel
  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, ratFuncEval_C, ratFuncEval_X, hevg] using hpush

This is the automorphism-level engine of both the differential constraint (§1) and the semilinear
clock (§3): all that is used is that `σ` preserves the rational subfield `C(y)`. -/

    (P : MvPolynomial (FullJetIndex m) ℂ)

theorem fullJet_independent_comp_mobius {m : ℕ} {U V : Set ℂ} (hUo : IsOpen U)
    {g : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ} (hg : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℂ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (g i) z) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    {a b c d : ℂ} (hdet : a * d - b * c ≠ 0) (hVden : ∀ v ∈ V, c * v + d ≠ 0)
    (hVU : ∀ v ∈ V, (a * v + b) / (c * v + d) ∈ U)
    (hind : ∀ Q : MvPolynomial (FullJetIndex m) ℂ,
      (∀ w ∈ V, MvPolynomial.eval (fullJetVec g ((a * w + b) / (c * w + d))) Q = 0) → Q = 0)
    (P : MvPolynomial (FullJetIndex m) ℂ)
    (hP : ∀ w ∈ V,
      MvPolynomial.eval (fullJetVec (fun i v => g i ((a * v + b) / (c * v + d))) w) P = 0) :
    P = 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with hc | hc
  · -- an affine change of variable
    have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
      intro hcon
      apply hdet
      rw [hc, hcon]
      ring
    have hane : a / d ≠ 0 := by
      refine div_ne_zero ?_ hd
      intro hcon
      apply hdet
      rw [hc, hcon]
      ring
    have hform : ∀ v : ℂ, (a / d) * v + b / d = (a * v + b) / (c * v + d) := by
      intro v
      rw [hc, zero_mul, zero_add]
      field_simp
    have hfam : (fun i v => g i ((a / d) * v + b / d))
        = fun i v => g i ((a * v + b) / (c * v + d)) := by
      funext i v
      rw [hform v]
    refine fullJet_independent_comp_affine (U := U) (V := V) (W := V) hUo hg hVo hane
      (fun v hv => by rw [hform v]; exact hVU v hv) (chi := id) (fun w hw => hw) ?_ P ?_
    · intro Q hQ
      refine hind Q fun w hw => ?_
      have := hQ w hw
      rw [show (id w : ℂ) = w from rfl, hform w] at this
      exact this
    · intro w hw
      rw [show (id w : ℂ) = w from rfl, hfam]
      exact hP w hw
  · -- a genuine Mobius change of variable
    have hBne : (b * c - a * d) / c ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      refine div_ne_zero ?_ (pow_ne_zero 2 hc)
      intro hcon
      apply hdet
      linear_combination -hcon
    have hCne : ∀ v ∈ V, v + d / c ≠ 0 := by
      intro v hv hcon
      refine hVden v hv ?_
      have hcv : c * (v + d / c) = c * v + d := by
        rw [mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ d hc]
      rw [← hcv, hcon, mul_zero]
    have hform : ∀ v ∈ V, (b * c - a * d) / c ^ 2 * (v + d / c)⁻¹ + a / c
        = (a * v + b) / (c * v + d) := by
      intro v hv
      have hvC : v + d / c ≠ 0 := hCne v hv
      have hden : c * v + d ≠ 0 := hVden v hv
      have hcv : c * (v + d / c) = c * v + d := by
        rw [mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ d hc]
      rw [← hcv]
      field_simp
      ring
    set A : ℂ := a / c with hA
    set C : ℂ := d / c with hC
    set B : ℂ := (b * c - a * d) / c ^ 2 with hB
    -- the intermediate families
    set U₂ : Set ℂ := {t : ℂ | B * t + A ∈ U} with hU₂
    have hU₂o : IsOpen U₂ := by
      rw [hU₂]
      exact hUo.preimage (by fun_prop)
    set g₂ : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ := fun i t => g i (B * t + A) with hg₂def
    have hg₂ : ∀ i, ∀ t ∈ U₂, ContDiffAt ℂ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (g₂ i) t := by
      intro i t ht
      exact (hg i _ ht).comp t (contDiffAt_affine B A t)
    set U₃ : Set ℂ := {u : ℂ | u ≠ 0 ∧ u⁻¹ ∈ U₂} with hU₃
    have hU₃o : IsOpen U₃ := isOpen_invDomain hU₂o
    set g₃ : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ := fun i u => g₂ i u⁻¹ with hg₃def
    have hg₃ : ∀ i, ∀ u ∈ U₃, ContDiffAt ℂ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (g₃ i) u := by
      intro i u hu
      exact (hg₂ i _ hu.2).comp u (contDiffAt_inv ℂ hu.1)
    have hchiA : ∀ w ∈ V, (w + C)⁻¹ ∈ U₂ := by
      intro w hw
      rw [hU₂]
      show B * (w + C)⁻¹ + A ∈ U
      rw [hform w hw]
      exact hVU w hw
    have hchiB : ∀ w ∈ V, w + C ∈ U₃ := by
      intro w hw
      exact ⟨hCne w hw, hchiA w hw⟩
    -- step one: the outer affine map
    have hind₂ : ∀ Q : MvPolynomial (FullJetIndex m) ℂ,
        (∀ w ∈ V, MvPolynomial.eval (fullJetVec g₂ ((w + C)⁻¹)) Q = 0) → Q = 0 := by
      intro Q hQ
      refine fullJet_independent_comp_affine (U := U) (V := U₂) (W := V) hUo hg hU₂o hBne
        (fun t ht => ht) (chi := fun w => (w + C)⁻¹) hchiA ?_ Q ?_
      · intro R hR
        refine hind R fun w hw => ?_
        have hval := hR w hw
        rw [hform w hw] at hval
        exact hval
      · exact hQ
    -- step two: the inversion
    have hind₃ : ∀ Q : MvPolynomial (FullJetIndex m) ℂ,
        (∀ w ∈ V, MvPolynomial.eval (fullJetVec g₃ (w + C)) Q = 0) → Q = 0 := by
      intro Q hQ
      refine fullJet_independent_comp_inv (U := U₂) (V := U₃) (W := V) hU₂o hg₂ hU₃o
        (fun u hu => hu.1) (fun u hu => hu.2) (chi := fun w => w + C) hchiB ?_ Q ?_
      · exact hind₂
      · exact hQ
    -- step three: the inner translation
    have hind₄ : ∀ Q : MvPolynomial (FullJetIndex m) ℂ,
        (∀ w ∈ V, MvPolynomial.eval (fullJetVec (fun i v => g₃ i (1 * v + C)) w) Q = 0) →
          Q = 0 := by
      intro Q hQ
      refine fullJet_independent_comp_affine (U := U₃) (V := {v : ℂ | 1 * v + C ∈ U₃})
        (W := V) hU₃o hg₃ ?_ one_ne_zero (fun t ht => ht) (chi := id) ?_ ?_ Q ?_
      · exact hU₃o.preimage (by fun_prop)
      · intro w hw
        show 1 * w + C ∈ U₃
        rw [one_mul]
        exact hchiB w hw
      · intro R hR
        refine hind₃ R fun w hw => ?_
        have hval := hR w hw
        rw [show (id w : ℂ) = w from rfl, one_mul] at hval
        exact hval
      · intro w hw
        rw [show (id w : ℂ) = w from rfl]
        exact hQ w hw
    -- the composed family is the Mobius precomposition on `V`
    refine hind₄ P fun w hw => ?_
    have hfam : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ V, (fun i v => g i ((a * v + b) / (c * v + d))) i v
        = (fun i v => g₃ i (1 * v + C)) i v := by
      intro i v hv
      show g i ((a * v + b) / (c * v + d)) = g₂ i (1 * v + C)⁻¹
      rw [hg₂def, one_mul]
      show g i ((a * v + b) / (c * v + d)) = g i (B * (v + C)⁻¹ + A)
      rw [hform v hv]
    rw [← fullJetVec_congr hVo hfam hw]
    exact hP w

by
  rw [summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)]
  constructor
  · intro k
    rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp [doubleTerm]
    · apply summable_of_hasFiniteSupport
      apply Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet (range (W.gridCount k + 1)))
      intro n hn
      simp only [Function.mem_support] at hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range]
      by_contra hnot
      have hlt : W.gridCount k < n := by omega
      rw [W.doubleTerm_eq_zero_of_gridCount_lt s hk hlt, norm_zero] at hn
      exact hn rfl
  · let sigma : ℝ := s.re
    let z : ℂ := ((sigma - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let V : ℝ := (eVariationOn W Set.univ).toReal
    let A : ℝ := V * (W.upper + 2) * W.lower ^ (-sigma)
    have hz : 1 < z.re := by
      dsimp only [z, sigma]
      simp only [ofReal_re]
      linarith
    have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hupper : 0 ≤ W.upper + 2 := by linarith [W.upper_pos]
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by
      dsimp only [A]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hV0 hupper)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg W.lower_pos.le _)
    have hvm : LSeriesSummable
        (fun k => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k : ℂ)) z :=
      ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hz
    have hmajor : Summable (fun k => A *
        ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) z k‖) :=
      hvm.norm.mul_left A
    apply Summable.of_norm_bounded hmajor
    intro k
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (tsum_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)]
    rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp [doubleTerm]
    · have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hk
      have hkreal : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
      have hcount : (W.gridCount k + 1 : ℕ) ≤
          (W.upper + 2) * (k : ℝ) := by
        have hD := W.gridCount_div_le_upper_add_one (show 1 ≤ k by omega)
        have hbase : (W.gridCount k : ℝ) ≤ (W.upper + 1) * (k : ℝ) := by
          exact (div_le_iff₀ hkreal).mp hD
        norm_num only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        nlinarith [show (1 : ℝ) ≤ k by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ k by omega)]
      rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := range (W.gridCount k + 1)) (fun n hn => by
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hn
        have hlt : W.gridCount k < n := by omega
        rw [W.doubleTerm_eq_zero_of_gridCount_lt s hk hlt, norm_zero])]
      calc
        (∑ n ∈ range (W.gridCount k + 1), ‖W.doubleTerm s (k, n)‖) ≤
            ∑ _n ∈ range (W.gridCount k + 1),
              ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k / Real.sqrt k * V *
                (W.lower * (k : ℝ)) ^ (-sigma) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro n hn
          simpa only [V, sigma] using W.norm_doubleTerm_le (by linarith : 0 < s.re) hk
        _ = (W.gridCount k + 1 : ℕ) *
              (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k / Real.sqrt k * V *
                (W.lower * (k : ℝ)) ^ (-sigma)) := by
          rw [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ((W.upper + 2) * (k : ℝ)) *
              (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k / Real.sqrt k * V *
                (W.lower * (k : ℝ)) ^ (-sigma)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount
          exact mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg
              (div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg k)) hV0)
            (Real.rpow_nonneg (mul_nonneg W.lower_pos.le hkreal.le) _)
        _ = A * ‖LSeries.term
              (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) z k‖ := by
          rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hk0, norm_div, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg,
            Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos hk, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
          simp only [z, ofReal_re]
          rw [Real.mul_rpow W.lower_pos.le hkreal.le]
          dsimp only [A]
          calc
            ((W.upper + 2) * (k : ℝ)) *
                (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * V *
                  (W.lower ^ (-sigma) * (k : ℝ) ^ (-sigma))) =
              (V * (W.upper + 2) * W.lower ^ (-sigma)) *
                (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k *
                  ((k : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) *
                    ((k : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * (k : ℝ) ^ (-sigma)))) := by
              rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg hkreal.le, Real.rpow_one]
              ring
            _ = (V * (W.upper + 2) * W.lower ^ (-sigma)) *
                (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k *
                  (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) + -sigma))) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hkreal, ← Real.rpow_add hkreal]
            _ = (V * (W.upper + 2) * W.lower ^ (-sigma)) *
                (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k /
                  (k : ℝ) ^ (sigma - 1 / 2)) := by
              rw [show 1 + (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) + -sigma) =

                Real.rpow_neg hkreal.le]

    f p.1 * g p.2 * Real.cos ((p.1 : ℝ) * z - (p.2 : ℝ) * z) with hM

    refine summable_prod_of_abs_bound hfa hga fun p => ?_
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hrep⟩ := hFrep p
    rw [hrep, abs_mul, abs_mul]

    ⟨Real.cos ((p.1 : ℝ) * z) * Real.cos ((p.2 : ℝ) * z), by
      rw [abs_mul]

    ⟨Real.cos ((p.1 : ℝ) * z + (p.2 : ℝ) * z), Real.abs_cos_le_one _, by rw [hP]⟩
  have hMs : Summable M := hbound M fun p =>
    ⟨Real.cos ((p.1 : ℝ) * z - (p.2 : ℝ) * z), Real.abs_cos_le_one _, by rw [hM]⟩

  have hfn : Summable fun j : ℤ => ‖f j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * z)‖ := by
    refine hfa.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) fun j => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_cos_le_one _)
  have hgn : Summable fun m : ℤ => ‖g m * Real.cos ((m : ℝ) * z)‖ := by
    refine hga.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) fun m => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_cos_le_one _)

    push_cast
    ring

    { toFun := fun q => (q.2, q.1 - q.2)
      invFun := fun p => (p.1 + p.2, p.1)
      left_inv := by intro q; simp
      right_inv := by intro p; simp }

  have hPsh : Summable fun q : ℤ × ℤ => P (sh q) := sh.summable_iff.mpr hPs

    rw [hPsh.tsum_prod, cosSeries]

      intro j

        = f j * g (k - j) * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * z)
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [tsum_congr hrw, tsum_mul_right, wienerConv]
  rw [hcauchy, hCP, hshear, hfold]
